weapons.name: N4 300 BLK Carbine
weapons.source_note: Noveske product page for its 300 Blackout barrels: "Precision 300 Blackout barrels in 7.94", 10.5", and 12.5" lengths, machined from 416R stainless with a 1:7 twist". A 1 turn in 7 inch twist = 7 x 25.4 = 177.8 mm per turn.

weapons.name: T-5000 Sniper Rifle (Bolt-Action)
weapons.source_note: Rosoboronexport (Russian state arms export agency) product page, specification table: "Cartridge .308 Win / Barrel length (inches/mm) 26/660 / Rifling pitch 11 / Number of rifles 4 (5R)". Rifling pitch 11 = 1 turn in 11 inches = 11 x 25.4 = 279.4 mm per turn. The table states 4 grooves (5R profile).

weapons.name: GI Expert full-size GI-spec 1911 with beavertail and combat sights
weapons.source_note: Para Ordnance GI Expert operator's manual, specification block: "Caliber: .45 ACP / Barrel: 5 inches, stainless steel / Twist: 1 in 16 inches, left-hand". A 1 turn in 16 inch twist = 16 x 25.4 = 406.4 mm per turn, left hand (Para barrel).

weapons.name: Elevation MTR 6.5 Creedmoor
weapons.source_note: Proof Research Elevation MTR product page, specification table under the "6.5 CM" (6.5 Creedmoor) caliber tab: "Twist Rate 7.5". A 1 turn in 7.5 inch twist = 7.5 x 25.4 = 190.5 mm per turn.

weapons.name: Mini Fix .300BO 9"
weapons.source_note: Q LLC owner's manual for THE FIX and mini FIX, specification table: "CALIBER 300 BLK / BARREL LENGTH 8 in / TWIST RATE 1:5". Q states a 1 turn in 5 inch twist for the .300 BLK barrel = 5 x 25.4 = 127.0 mm per turn. The TSV barrel length (9 in) differs; Q's .300 BLK Mini Fix barrel is listed as 8 in.

weapons.name: M2010 Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: Remington Military XM2010 (type-classified M2010 Enhanced Sniper Rifle) product page, specification table: "Caliber .300 Winchester Magnum ... Barrel 22" 5R Profile, 1 turn in 10" RH". A 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 10 x 25.4 = 254.0 mm per turn, right hand.

weapons.name: M24 Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: Remington Military M24 product page, specification table: "Barrel 24", 416R Stainless Steel, 5R, 1:11.25 Twist". A 1 turn in 11.25 inch twist = 11.25 x 25.4 = 285.75 mm per turn.

weapons.name: 1911-A1 classic GI-spec 1911A1 reproduction, parkerized
weapons.source_note: Armscor/Rock Island Armory 1911 A1/A2 owner's manual, technical specifications table (covers the full-size 1911A1 model): "Rifling Twist ... Right hand, 1 turn in 400mm" and "No. Of Grooves 6". Armscor prints 400 mm, the metric rounding of 1 turn in 16 inches = 16 x 25.4 = 406.4 mm per turn, right hand.

weapons.name: M200 service revolver, 6-shot, 4" barrel, fixed sights
weapons.source_note: Armscor/Rock Island Armory revolver owner's manual, specification table: "Rifling Twist  Right Hand Twist, 1 Turn in 400mm (16")" and "No. of Grooves  6". Armscor equates its 400 mm figure to 1 turn in 16 inches = 16 x 25.4 = 406.4 mm per turn, right hand.
